tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page and packaging ground. Default background for the site, inserts and care cards.

tokens.name: lilac-mist
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: product cards, sachet back panels, section bands. Pairs with cream; never as text.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: The brand color. Box sleeves, sachet fronts, hero blocks. Fill only; set text on it in plum (5.8:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Add to bag, Subscribe) with cream text (6.9:1). Also links on cream and lilac-mist.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Ink. Headlines, body copy and the wordmark on cream, lilac-mist, lavender and apricot.

tokens.name: plum-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, ingredient lists, legal lines. On cream (5.6:1) and lilac-mist (4.7:1) only.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: The heat cue. Small warm accents: the glow dot, a sticker, the 8-hour badge. Fill only, never text on cream; plum text on it reads 6.1:1.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers, input borders on cream, box fold lines on mockups. Decorative only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines on site and box front. One per view.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Peel, place over clothing, and let the warmth settle in.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Iron powder, activated carbon, vermiculite, salt, water.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, badges, nav. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between stacked elements.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sachets, image frames. The default soft corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips. Echoes the moon and the round patch.
